The {{PAGENAME}} can be found in the northern section of the [[Wheat Farm]] during the day. He sells grain products. He is the brother of the [[Farmer]]. As his mill does not work, he is always found saying  "I get so tired without any work to do." until the quest is completed.

==Quests==
===Fixing the Mill===
Doing [[Ms. Charm]]'s quest line will eventually lead you to being asked to fix the broken [[mill]]. You have to talk to the miller first. Then seek help at the [[astrologer]] to figure out the {{Item|paper with calculations}}. Then return to the mill to complete the project.

{| class="wikitable"
! Icon
! style="width:17.5em;" |Materials Required
! style="width:5em;" |Energy
|-
|[[File:Mill item.png|center|80x80px]]
|{{Item|Complex iron parts|5}}<br> {{Item|Wooden plank|6}}<br> {{Item|Paper with calculations|1}}
|{{Energy}}30
|}

After fixing the [[mill]], go back to the [[farmer]] and talk to him. You will get Alisa's Papers and from now on, you will be able to mill your {{Item|Wheat|10}} into {{Item|flour|15}} for free.

==Trades==
Miller is bugged in that he is unable to resell {{Item|Firewood}}. Once he runs out of money, he'll be unable to restock his inventory. To remedy that, trade with him until his stock reaches the base amount (i.e. If he has {{Item|Hops|5|gold}} in stock, he'll start making money again).
